metadata.value: GRANDE requires categorical features to be encoded appropriately. The best results are achieved using Leave-One-Out Encoding for high-cardinality categorical features and One-Hot Encoding for low-cardinality categorical features. Furthermore, all features should be normalized using a quantile transformation. Passing the categorical indices to the model wil automatically preprocess the data accordingly.
